# Webhook events and deliveries

A project may have up to 10 endpoints (Professional and Enterprise). Each delivery is a POST with a JSON body `{ "id", "type", "createdAt", "data" }`; verify it with `verifyWebhook` from `@opem/node` and the endpoint's `whsec_` secret before trusting it.

## Events

| Event | When | `data` holds |
|---|---|---|
| `request.created` | A request is raised in the widget, a hand-off from the assistant included. | request |
| `request.replied` | Your team replies: in the dashboard, through the management API, or by replying to Opem's email. | request, message (the reply and its channel: dashboard, api or email) |
| `request.closed` | A request is closed: in the dashboard, with a reply sent with Close, or through the management API. | request, closedBy (staff or api) |
| `answer.given` | The assistant answers in the widget with some text. | answer (who asked, the question, the answer, whether it read a document) |
| `answer.handed_over` | A person hands an answer over to your team, which raises a request too. | answer.id, request |

## Headers

| Header | Value |
|---|---|
| `Opem-Signature` | v1= and the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the signed string, with the endpoint's secret |
| `Opem-Timestamp` | when Opem signed this attempt, in unix seconds |
| `Opem-Delivery` | the delivery's id: the same on every attempt, new on a redelivery |
| `Opem-Event` | the event, as in the body's type |

## Signature

The signature header carries `v1=` and the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256, with the endpoint's secret, of the timestamp header, a full stop and the raw body. A delivery whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes from now is refused as stale, so your server's clock must be right. Verify the raw body bytes, before any JSON parsing or re-serialising.

## Retries and timeouts

Opem waits 10 seconds for a `2xx`. A failed attempt is retried after 1 minute, then 10 minutes, then 1 hour, then 6 hours, then 16 hours; the delivery id stays the same across attempts and changes on a redelivery you trigger from the dashboard. Deliveries are logged for 30 days on the Configuration page, Webhooks tab, where a delivery can be replayed.
